name: trainingapp-desktop
description: Electron shell for the TrainingApp web_ui renderer (issue #59 acceptance checks)

scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "npm --prefix ../web_ui run dev" "npm run compile && electron . --dev"
scripts.desktop:build: npm --prefix ../web_ui run build && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('../web_ui/dist', 'renderer', { recursive: true })" && npm run compile && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
